jobs.occupation: Technician in Electro-Mechanics (TiPODS - AURORA - STRATUS) M/W/X
jobs.description:
WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
 

MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 March 2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2031. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. 
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Customs Coordinator | West-Flanders Area
jobs.description:
Our client is a long-established industrial manufacturer with production sites in Belgium and abroad, supplying high-performance chemical solutions to globally recognised premium brands. Supported by private equity investors, the organisation is evolving from a traditional setup towards a more modern, performance-driven operating model. The company is located in the north West Flanders area.

Jobomschrijving

The Customs Specialist will:

• Become a key member of a team of five customer service professionals, managing the complete order-to-cash process for an international B2B customer portfolio.
• Oversee and manage customs documentation and trade compliance activities for international import and export transactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, building strong relationships and ensuring an excellent service experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.
• Proactively manage customer enquiries, orders, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics, production, and sales teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments.
• Collaborate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to facilitate smooth and compliant cross-border shipments.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital transformation projects, helping modernise processes and enhance customer service efficiency.

The Customs Specialist we are looking for has:

• At least 3 years of experience in customer service, order management, logistics coordination and/or customs within an international B2B environment.
• A genuine customer-centric mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP is a strong asset).
• Knowledge of customs processes and international trade compliance requirements.
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French and/or German are considered an advantage.
• The flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a changing environment and support process improvements.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - Dutch speaking
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established industrial company with operations across Belgium and several international locations. To support its continued growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to take ownership of the full accounting cycle and act as a key financial partner within the organization.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Accountant, you will be responsible for the end-to-end accounting process for one or several legal entities:

• Manage the full accounting cycle (A-Z accounting)
• Processing and reviewing purchase, sales, and general ledger entries
• Managing accruals, provisions, and reconciliations
• Monitoring accounts payable and accounts receivable activities
• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual closings
• Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting
• Perform balance sheet reconciliations and variance analyses
• Prepare statutory and management reports
• Handle tax and compliance matters
• VAT declarations and related tax filings
• Support external audits and liaise with auditors
• Ensure compliance with local accounting regulations and internal policies
• Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis activities
• Collaborate closely with local and international stakeholders, including Finance, Controlling, Operations, and Shared Service Centers
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, controls, and reporting tools

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior accounting position
• Strong knowledge of general accounting principles and financial reporting
• Experience managing the full accounting cycle from bookkeeping through closing and reporting
• Comfortable working in an international, multi-entity environment
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail
• Proactive, autonomous, and solution-oriented approach
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• Dutch: Professional proficiency (mandatory)
• English: Professional proficiency (mandatory)
• French: Strong asset
